decision: Clarify library reuse and explicitly scoped package installation as agent policy
rationale: Python-only deterministic work does not imply standard-library-only applications. Reusing suitable libraries avoids unnecessary custom implementations while approval and virtual environments keep dependencies deliberate.
alternatives: An automatic dependency installer would change runtime behavior beyond the requested policy clarification.
A standard-library-only application restriction would unnecessarily prevent suitable third-party reuse.
outcome: Shared rules, initialization/configuration guidance, workflow documentation and core role instructions now express the same reuse and installation policy; the core harness stays dependency-free.
